fact: On 16 September 2026 lawyers for Vice-President Teodoro Nguema Obiang Mangue filed four criminal complaints at Malabo's Juzgado de Instrucción Número I under Ley 7/2024 against a Diario Rombe journalist and three others, citing the false-news offence of article 50 that carries 2 to 4 years in prison.
title: Los abogados de Nguema Obiang Mangue presentan cuatro querellas criminales contra Diario Rombe, Luz María y otras dos personas
